code.license: Apache-2.0 (repository code; dataset card separately reports MIT data license)

dataset.full_release_size_note: Hugging Face dataset card reports approximately 50.3 GB; exact byte total not used for pilot.

predeclared_subset.episodes: All released complete episodes with numeric ids 10 and 100-115 for each selected task; no result-dependent selection.
predeclared_subset.camera_mapping: Decoded samples verified Camera1 is the visuo-tactile sensor image and Camera2 is the wrist/scene vision stream.
predeclared_subset.split: Primary: numeric episode-disjoint 75/25 split within each task; secondary: Stamp and UsbPlug train with all FragileCup episodes held out as task-shift test.
predeclared_subset.expected_download_bytes: computed from API file metadata before download; must be recorded in subset_manifest.json
predeclared_subset.contact_definition_predeclared: contact = tactile Camera1 timepoints whose mean absolute pixel change from the first frame exceeds 0.012 (normalized 0-1 RGB), sustained for 3 frames; threshold chosen from the data-only audit before model fitting and then frozen
